## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -2.65% | 1M: -14.09%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and SPY_TLT (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +0.77%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND show risk tilt, while HYG/LQD signaling CREDIT STRESS ↑ with HYG (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.74% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND creates the offsetting confirmation.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress creeping higher: HYG/LQD CREDIT STRESS ↑ (HYG (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION; LQD (1W: -0.74% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND). Fear easing and risk propping: VXX (1W: -2.65% | 1M: -14.09%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +0.44%) ABOVE TREND / TLT (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -0.74%) BELOW TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tight: SPY (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +0.44%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -0.74%) BELOW TREND shows stocks outpacing long bonds (SPY_TLT ↑ rising), while Dollar strength level (1W: -0.60% | 1M: -0.64%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND keeps FX tailwinds muted.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +0.03%) CORRECTION while Financials (XLF) showing relative resilience (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -0.09%) ABOVE TREND — style mixed with cyclicals/energy outperforming growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US marginally stronger: SPY (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +0.44%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: -0.48% | 1M: +0.05%) CORRECTION versus EM pockets; EEM (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +2.66%) CORRECTION and China FXI (1W: +0.28% | 1M: -2.05%) RECOVERY.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Risk-on niches intact: IBIT (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +26.16%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and ETHA (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +31.35%) ABOVE TREND, while small caps IWM (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -1.53%) BELOW TREND show limited breadth under the surface.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodities leadership: USO (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +23.69%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +23.10%) ABOVE TREND reflect energy-driven inflation impulses; CPER (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.30%) BELOW TREND signals industrial metals softness.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strong: XLE (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +23.10%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +23.69%) ABOVE TREND; NatGas UNG (1W: +0.58% | 1M: +7.70%) ABOVE TREND but watch volatility.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Energy leadership (XLE both timeframes positive) and risk sentiment easing (VXX ↓ falling). DIVERGENCE: Tech (XLK 1W negative | 1M ~flat → CORRECTION) and various thematic/commodities (ARKK, GLD, SLV) show 1W vs 1M mismatches — two-factor opposite signals keep regime neutral.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy and selective cyclicals showing strength (XLE (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND; XLF (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -0.09%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to lagging tech (XLK (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +0.03%) CORRECTION); bonds (TLT (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -0.74%) BELOW TREND) remain neutral to defensive given rising credit stress.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Semiconductors — SOXX (1W: -4.42% | 1M: -5.37%) BELOW TREND and broader Industrials XLI (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil — USO (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +23.69%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +23.10%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Copper — CPER (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.30%) BELOW TREND; Gold GLD (1W: -2.93% | 1M: +5.28%) CORRECTION to monitor as inflation hedge.

**13. Key Levels?**
Watch VXX near 20 (VXX (1W: -2.65% | 1M: -14.09%) BELOW TREND) for complacency, HYG/LQD ~0.75–0.80 as a credit-health signal (HYG (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION; LQD (1W: -0.74% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND), and XLK/ XLF spread for growth vs value pivot (XLK (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +0.03%) CORRECTION; XLF (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -0.09%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive with energy and select cyclicals showing relative strength (XLE (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND; XLF (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -0.09%) ABOVE TREND) while tech is in CORRECTION (XLK (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +0.03%) CORRECTION). Key risk is rising credit stress (HYG/LQD CREDIT STRESS ↑ with HYG (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.74% | 1M: -0.75%) BELOW TREND) amid fading volatility (VXX (1W: -2.65% | 1M: -14.09%) ↓ falling).
